summary: This video breaks down Vortex performance data from top players on the Chinese live server following the release of the Options Summon II banner. Neff Gaming demonstrates how upgrading Rhyviel's Inspiration level drastically increases Vortex damage output. For example, moving Rhyviel from Inspiration 1 to Inspiration 2 provided a 14 billion damage jump without significant gear changes. At Inspiration 5, top teams reached nearly 96.7 billion damage during Week 3 of the Continental Challenge.
